info.title: Tunisia Open Data
info.description: Tunisia Open Data is the national open government data portal of the Republic of Tunisia. The public site data.gov.tn is a content-managed shell; this connector targets the CKAN catalogue behind it at catalog.data.gov.tn. It searches the dataset catalogue, reads dataset, publishing organisation and resource metadata, and lists the licences and topic groups in use. Dataset metadata is published in French, with parallel Arabic fields.

get.description: Searches the Tunisia Open Data catalogue and returns the matching datasets with their full metadata, resources and tags. Use the Search Query option for free text and the Filter Query option to restrict results to a publishing organisation, a file format or another indexed field. Dataset titles and descriptions are published in French and Arabic.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The free text to search for across dataset titles, descriptions and tags. Leave this empty to return the whole catalogue. French and Arabic text are both accepted.

parameters.name: fq
parameters.description: A filter that restricts the results to an indexed field, written as field:value, for example organization:institut-national-de-la-statistique or res_format:CSV. Combine several filters by separating them with a space.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The order the results are returned in, written as a field name followed by asc or desc, for example metadata_modified desc. The portal sorts by relevance and then by most recently modified when this is left empty.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: The maximum number of datasets to return in one call. The portal returns 20 datasets when this is left empty.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The number of datasets to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

409.description: The Search Query or Filter Query option could not be parsed by the portal search engine.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

post.description: Searches the Tunisia Open Data catalogue by sending the search options in a request body rather than in the query string. Use this operation when a query or filter value is long enough or contains enough punctuation to be awkward in a query string.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The search options sent to the portal.

409.description: The Search Query or Filter Query option could not be parsed by the portal search engine.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the full metadata of a single dataset, including every resource attached to it, its tags, its publishing organisation and its licence. Supply either the dataset name used in the portal address or the dataset identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the dataset, or the short name that appears in the portal address, for example recensement-2014.

404.description: No dataset exists with the supplied identifier or name.

409.description: The Dataset ID or Name option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every dataset published on the portal as a plain list of text values. Use one of the returned names with the Get dataset operation to read the full metadata of that dataset.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns datasets whose name or title begins with the text you supply, as a short suggestion list of names and titles. Use this to look up a dataset name before calling the Get dataset operation. An empty search text returns no suggestions, so always supply at least one character.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text a dataset name or title must begin with. At least one character is required, because an empty value returns no suggestions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every government ministry, authority and agency that publishes data on the portal, as a plain list of text values. Use one of the returned names with the Get organisation operation to read the full details of that organisation.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the details of a single publishing organisation, including its display title, its description and the number of datasets it has published. Organisation titles on this portal are usually the organisation's acronym, with the full name in the Description property.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the organisation, or its short name as returned by the List organisations operation, for example institut-national-de-la-statistique.

404.description: No organisation exists with the supplied identifier or name.

409.description: The Organisation ID or Name option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns publishing organisations whose name or title matches the text you supply, with the short name and the full title of each one. An empty search text returns the first organisations on the portal, so this operation can also be used to list them with their titles.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text the organisation name or title must match. Leave this empty to return organisations without filtering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of suggestions to return. The portal returns 20 when this is left empty.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the metadata of a single resource, which is one downloadable file belonging to a dataset. The metadata includes the download address, the file format and the internet media type of the resource.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the resource, taken from the Resources list of a dataset returned by the Get dataset or Search datasets operation.

404.description: No resource exists with the supplied identifier.

409.description: The Resource ID option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Searches the resources of the portal by the value of a single resource field, written as field:value. Only stored resource fields such as format, name, description and url can be searched.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The field and value to match, written as field:value, for example format:CSV. Only stored resource fields such as format, name, description and url can be searched.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: The name of the resource field the results are ordered by, for example name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of resources to return in one call.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of resources to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

200.description: The search completed. The Count property reports how many resources matched.

409.description: The Field Query option named a resource field that cannot be searched.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the views configured for one resource. A view is a preview the portal renders for a resource, such as the built-in data table explorer.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identifier of the resource whose views are returned.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the short name of every topic group defined on the portal, such as sante, education or agriculture. Use a returned name with the Filter Query option, or to browse datasets by topic.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns every keyword used across the datasets of the portal as a plain list of text values, most of them in French. This portal's global tag index is populated.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns every licence the portal offers for its datasets, with the identifier that appears in the Licence ID property of a dataset and the address of the full licence text.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

get.description: Returns the file formats used by resources on the portal that match the text you supply, such as csv, xlsx or pdf. An empty search text returns formats without filtering. Use a returned format with the Filter Query option of the Search datasets operation.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The text the file format must contain. Leave this empty to return formats without filtering.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of formats to return. The portal returns five when this is left empty.

409.description: A required option was missing or not valid.

500.description: The portal encountered an internal error.

q.description: The free text to search for across dataset titles, descriptions and tags. Leave this empty to return the whole catalogue. French and Arabic text are both accepted.

fq.description: A filter that restricts the results to an indexed field, written as field:value, for example organization:institut-national-de-la-statistique or res_format:CSV. Combine several filters by separating them with a space.

sort.description: The order the results are returned in, written as a field name followed by asc or desc, for example metadata_modified desc.

rows.description: The maximum number of datasets to return in one call. The portal returns 20 datasets when this is left empty.

start.description: The number of datasets to skip before the first returned result, used to page through a large result set.

Resource.description: One downloadable file belonging to a dataset.

id.description: The identifier of the resource, used by the Get resource operation.

package_id.description: The identifier of the dataset the resource belongs to.

name.description: The name of the resource, usually published in French.

url.description: The web address the resource can be downloaded from.

url_type.description: How the resource is held by the portal, for example upload for a file stored on the portal.

format.description: The file format of the resource, for example CSV or PPTX.

mimetype.description: The internet media type of the resource, for example text/csv.

mimetype_inner.description: The internet media type of the file held inside the resource when the resource is an archive.

size.description: The size of the resource in bytes. This portal returns it inconsistently across records, sometimes as a number, sometimes as a text value and most often as no value at all, so no fixed type is declared here.

hash.description: The checksum of the resource contents, used by the portal to detect changes.

state.description: Whether the resource is active or has been deleted.

resource_type.description: The type the publisher has assigned to the resource.

position.description: The position of the resource in the resource list of its dataset, counting from zero.

created.description: The date and time the resource was added to the portal.

last_modified.description: The date and time the contents of the resource were last changed.

metadata_modified.description: The date and time the metadata of the resource was last changed.

cache_url.description: The web address of the cached copy of the resource held by the portal.

cache_last_updated.description: The date and time the cached copy of the resource was last refreshed.

datastore_active.description: Whether the rows of the resource are queryable through the CKAN DataStore. This has been observed false on every resource checked on this portal, so this connector does not expose DataStore query operations.

name_ar.description: The Arabic name of the resource. Often blank.

description_ar.description: The Arabic description of the resource. Often blank.

downloads_count.description: The number of times the resource has been downloaded through the CKAN catalogue.

downloads_count_cms.description: The number of times the resource has been downloaded through the public data.gov.tn site.

DatasetTag.description: A keyword attached to a dataset.

name.description: The text of the tag, usually published in French.

display_name.description: The text of the tag as it is shown on the portal.

state.description: Whether the tag is active or has been deleted.

vocabulary_id.description: The identifier of the controlled vocabulary the tag belongs to, when the tag is not a free text tag.

DatasetGroup.description: A topic group a dataset has been placed in, as returned inside the dataset.

id.description: The identifier of the topic group.

name.description: The short name of the topic group, for example habitat.

title.description: The title of the topic group.

display_name.description: The title of the topic group as it is shown on the portal.

description.description: The description of the topic group.

image_display_url.description: The web address of the icon of the topic group.

DatasetOrganization.description: The organisation that published a dataset, as it is returned inside the dataset.

id.description: The identifier of the publishing organisation.

name.description: The short name of the publishing organisation, for example institut-national-de-la-statistique.

title.description: The title of the publishing organisation. This is usually the organisation's acronym on this portal, with the full name in the Description property.

description.description: The description of the publishing organisation, usually its full name.

image_url.description: The web address of the logo of the publishing organisation.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the organisation record.

state.description: Whether the publishing organisation is active or has been deleted.

approval_status.description: Whether the publishing organisation has been approved on the portal.

is_organization.description: Whether the record is an organisation rather than a group.

created.description: The date and time the publishing organisation was added to the portal.

title_ar.description: The Arabic title of the organisation. Often blank.

description_ar.description: The Arabic description of the organisation. Often blank.

siteweb.description: The organisation's own website, when recorded.

Dataset.description: A dataset published on the portal, together with its resources and tags.

name.description: The short name of the dataset, as it appears in the portal address.

title.description: The title of the dataset, usually published in French.

title_ar.description: The Arabic title of the dataset. Publishers do not always fill this in, so it can repeat the French title or be blank.

notes.description: The description of the dataset, usually published in French.

notes_ar.description: The Arabic description of the dataset. Publishers do not always fill this in.

url.description: The web address of the original source of the dataset.

state.description: Whether the dataset is active or has been deleted.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the record, normally dataset.

private.description: Whether the dataset is private. Only public datasets are returned by this connector.

isopen.description: Whether the licence of the dataset is recognised as an open licence.

version.description: The version the publisher has recorded for the dataset.

license_id.description: The identifier of the licence of the dataset, matching a licence returned by the List licences operation.

license_title.description: The title of the licence of the dataset.

author.description: The name of the author of the dataset.

author_email.description: The email address of the author of the dataset.

maintainer.description: The name of the person who maintains the dataset.

maintainer_email.description: The email address of the person who maintains the dataset.

owner_org.description: The identifier of the organisation that published the dataset.

creator_user_id.description: The identifier of the portal account that created the dataset.

metadata_created.description: The date and time the dataset was added to the portal.

metadata_modified.description: The date and time the dataset metadata was last changed.

num_resources.description: The number of resources attached to the dataset.

num_tags.description: The number of tags attached to the dataset.

resources.description: The downloadable files attached to the dataset.

tags.description: The keywords attached to the dataset.

groups.description: The topic groups the dataset belongs to, such as habitat or sante. Use the List groups operation to see the full list of topics.

national_theme.description: The national data theme the publisher assigned to the dataset. Often blank.

spatial_geoLevel.description: The geographic level the dataset covers, for example national or regional. Often blank.

spatial_geoName.description: The name of the geographic area the dataset covers. Often blank.

spatial_locationType.description: The type of location the dataset is scoped to. Often blank.

spatial_locationValue.description: The specific location the dataset is scoped to. Often blank.

temporal_startDate.description: The start of the time period the dataset covers. Often blank.

temporal_endDate.description: The end of the time period the dataset covers. Often blank.

temporal_frequency.description: How often the dataset is updated, for example annuelle. Often blank.

tag_string_fr.description: The dataset tags in French as a single comma-separated string. Returned by the search operations rather than by Get dataset.

tag_string_ar.description: The dataset tags in Arabic as a single comma-separated string. Returned by the search operations rather than by Get dataset.

rating.description: The average user rating of the dataset, from 1 to 5.

ratings_count.description: The number of user ratings the dataset has received.

reuses_list.description: The registered reuses of the dataset, each as a free-form object. Usually empty.

extras.description: Additional metadata items recorded against the dataset as name and value pairs.

Organization.description: A government ministry, authority or agency that publishes data on the portal.

name.description: The short name of the organisation, for example institut-national-de-la-statistique.

title.description: The title of the organisation. This is usually the organisation's acronym on this portal, with the full name in the Description property.

title_ar.description: The Arabic title of the organisation.

display_name.description: The name of the organisation as it is shown on the portal.

description.description: The description of the organisation, usually its full name in French.

description_ar.description: The Arabic description of the organisation.

image_url.description: The web address of the logo of the organisation.

image_display_url.description: The full web address the portal uses to display the logo of the organisation.

type.description: The type the portal has assigned to the organisation record.

state.description: Whether the organisation is active or has been deleted.

approval_status.description: Whether the organisation has been approved on the portal.

is_organization.description: Whether the record is an organisation rather than a group.

package_count.description: The number of datasets the organisation has published.

num_followers.description: The number of portal accounts that follow the organisation.

created.description: The date and time the organisation was added to the portal.

siteweb.description: The organisation's own website, when recorded.

License.description: A licence a dataset can be published under.

id.description: The identifier of the licence, as used by the Licence ID property of a dataset.

url.description: The web address of the full licence text.

family.description: The licence family the licence belongs to.

maintainer.description: The organisation that maintains the licence.

status.description: Whether the licence is active on the portal.

od_conformance.description: Whether the licence conforms to the Open Definition.

osd_conformance.description: Whether the licence conforms to the Open Source Definition.

is_generic.description: Whether the licence is a generic one rather than a named public licence.

domain_content.description: Whether the licence is intended for content.

domain_data.description: Whether the licence is intended for data.

domain_software.description: Whether the licence is intended for software.

is_okd_compliant.description: Whether the licence complies with the Open Knowledge Definition.

is_osi_compliant.description: Whether the licence complies with the Open Source Initiative definition.

title_ar.description: The Arabic title of the licence.

SearchDatasetsResult.description: The datasets that matched the search, with the total number of matches.

count.description: The total number of datasets that matched the search, which can be larger than the number returned.

sort.description: The sort order the portal applied to the results.

results.description: The datasets that matched the search.

facets.description: The counts of matching datasets grouped by field value. The portal returns this empty unless facets were requested.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

success.description: Whether the portal completed the request successfully.

ResourceView.description: A preview the portal renders for a resource.

DatasetExtra.description: An additional metadata item recorded against a dataset.
